description: Structured eligibility for each resource, built from the approved prose criteria (owner decisions 2026-11-13). Loaded by `make structure-rules`, which creates a NEW PENDING version of each approved record; nothing goes live until the owner approves it in /admin. Texts come from the approved record's prose criteria; where one was split, reworded or moved, the owner sees the change in the /admin diff before approving. kind=rule is evaluated by the matcher against a field in data/profile_fields.json. kind=office is a judgment the office makes; it is shown on the ticket as 'The office decides this' and does not block a yes. steps_add, docs_add and note_add move prose that is not eligibility (steps, limits, documents) out of the criteria.
